title: Recover a lost Gradle tool session by workflow ID

rubric.text: Uses gradle_run.py status --workflow aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa as the standalone recovery command and retains the original workflow rather than creating or running another build.
Explains run identity and the stored bounded result with result_sequence; while running, an available result can belong to the previous run. Does not suggest reading raw logs.

Waits or polls status on running, checks exit_status for completed including failures, uses recorded signal evidence for interrupted, and reports uncertain without inferring completion from PID existence or absence.
